_note: Templates. {UPPERCASE} blocks are drawn fresh; {lowercase} fields are what the story kept; {the_thing}, {the_someone}, {the_message}, {the_disaster} pick up something an earlier beat introduced (favored when it exists, never used when it doesn't).
